persona.zh-CN: 49岁女性，公司法务。坚持盖章和承诺性结论必须律师或业务确认，对漏抽关键条款和幻觉约定零容忍。
persona.en-US: 49-year-old female, company counsel. Insists seal and commitment conclusions need counsel or the business owner, and has zero tolerance for a missed material clause or an invented term.

concerns.zh-CN: 代理会不会漏掉终止或赔偿条款？
concerns.en-US: Could the agent miss a termination or indemnity clause?

concerns.zh-CN: 模型会不会写出原文里没有的约定？
concerns.en-US: Will the model write a term that is not in the source?

concerns.zh-CN: 盖章结论能不能在没有律师确认时发出？
concerns.en-US: Can a sealed conclusion go out without counsel confirmation?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解业务清积压的速度压力
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand the business pressure to clear the pile

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了扫描件解析失败对抽取的伤害
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates how failed scan parsing hurts extraction

persona.zh-CN: 44岁男性，业务负责人。要速度，希望代理直接出结论清掉文件堆，时常低估幻觉约定会变成对外承诺。
persona.en-US: 44-year-old male, business owner. Wants speed, hopes the agent will issue conclusions and clear the pile, and often underestimates that an invented term becomes an external commitment.

concerns.zh-CN: 审核能不能跟上签约窗口？
concerns.en-US: Can review keep up with the signing window?

concerns.zh-CN: 每份都等律师会不会把交易拖死？
concerns.en-US: Will waiting for counsel on every file kill the deal?

concerns.zh-CN: 代理结论我能不能直接当业务意见用？
concerns.en-US: Can I treat the agent conclusion as the business opinion?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解漏掉要害条款会把公司锁进坏合同
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know a missed material clause can lock the company into a bad contract

blindSpots.zh-CN: 看不到文档运营处理扫描件失败的负担
blindSpots.en-US: Cannot see the ops burden of failed scans

persona.zh-CN: 36岁女性，负责文件堆与解析流水线。疲于处理扫描件和积压，希望解析到主数据比对能跑通，又担心模型在页缝补写。
persona.en-US: 36-year-old female, owns the document pile and parse pipeline. Exhausted by scans and backlog, wants parse-through-master-data-match to run, and worries the model will invent text at page breaks.

concerns.zh-CN: 扫描件解析失败时后面的抽取还能不能用？
concerns.en-US: If scan parsing fails, can downstream extraction still be used?

concerns.zh-CN: 积压要怎样才能开始下降？
concerns.en-US: What would it take for the backlog to start falling?

concerns.zh-CN: 规则引擎和主数据对不齐时运营怎么收场？
concerns.en-US: How does ops recover when the rule engine and master data do not align?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解律师对承诺性结论的红线
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know counsel's red line on commitment conclusions

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了采购会把代理输出当已审意见
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates that procurement will treat agent output as already reviewed

persona.zh-CN: 41岁男性，采购。要供应商合同尽快过审，倾向相信抽取结果，低估幻觉约定和漏条款。
persona.en-US: 41-year-old male, procurement. Wants vendor contracts cleared quickly, tends to trust extraction output, and underestimates invented terms and missed clauses.

concerns.zh-CN: 供应商合同能不能在窗口内过审？
concerns.en-US: Can vendor contracts clear inside the window?

concerns.zh-CN: 主数据比对会不会把合格供应商卡住？
concerns.en-US: Will master-data match block a qualified vendor?

concerns.zh-CN: 代理标出来的风险我能不能当已确认？
concerns.en-US: Can I treat risks the agent flagged as already confirmed?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解盖章结论必须律师或业务确认
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know sealed conclusions need counsel or the business owner

blindSpots.zh-CN: 看不到页缝和表格处漏抽的规律
blindSpots.en-US: Cannot see the pattern of misses at page breaks and tables

text.zh-CN: 文档进线后先解析或走 OCR/视觉模型，再做条款抽取。
text.en-US: After a document arrives, it is parsed or run through OCR/VLM, then clause extraction.

text.zh-CN: 抽取结果走规则引擎，再与主数据比对；积压约1.2万份。
text.en-US: Extraction results go through the rule engine, then master-data match; the backlog is about 12,000 files.

text.zh-CN: 法务和业务都在等审核；抽查漏条款约9%。
text.en-US: Counsel and the business are both waiting on review; spot checks miss about 9% of clauses.

text.zh-CN: 采购要速度，律师要准确；扫描件经常解析失败。
text.en-US: Procurement wants speed, counsel wants accuracy; scans often fail to parse.

text.zh-CN: 规则只覆盖常见模板，非标合同条款对不齐。
text.en-US: Rules only cover common templates; nonstandard contract clauses do not align.

text.zh-CN: 模型会在页缝或表格处漏抽，也会补上文档里没有的约定。
text.en-US: The model misses clauses at page breaks or tables, and also fills in terms that are not in the document.

text.zh-CN: 漏掉终止或赔偿条款会把公司锁进坏合同。
text.en-US: Missing a termination or indemnity clause locks the company into a bad contract.

text.zh-CN: 业务负责人想先清积压；律师认为一次幻觉约定就会对外承诺。
text.en-US: The business owner wants to clear the backlog first; counsel believes one invented term becomes an external commitment.

text.zh-CN: 盖章或承诺性结论必须律师或业务确认。
text.en-US: Seal or commitment conclusions require confirmation from counsel or the business owner.

text.zh-CN: 合同原文不得出境到第三方大模型。
text.en-US: Contract source text must not leave the region to a third-party LLM.

text.zh-CN: 目标：解析到主数据比对成为默认审核路径，积压开始下降。
text.en-US: Goal: parse-through-master-data-match becomes the default review path, and the backlog starts to fall.

text.zh-CN: 质量红线：关键条款不得漏抽，不得出现文档中不存在的约定。
text.en-US: Quality floor: material clauses must not be missed, and terms that are not in the document must not appear.

text.zh-CN: 业务不信人工审核速度，想让代理直接出结论。
text.en-US: The business does not trust human review speed and wants the agent to issue conclusions directly.

text.zh-CN: 律师不信抽取；采购低估幻觉约定的风险。
text.en-US: Counsel does not trust extraction; procurement underestimates the risk of an invented term.
It hallucinates a term that does not exist.
